Watch the Official Trailer Sources From Season 4 arrives in just 18 days, and MGM+ is ready to trap viewers in a nightmare of terrifying mysteries. The sci-fi horror series returns Sunday, April 19 with a chilling new season that promises darker secrets than ever before. Prepare for answers that come at a devastating cost. 🔥 Quick Facts Premiere Date: Sunday, April 19, 2026 at 9:00 PM ET/PT on MGM+ Cast Returning: Harold Perrineau, Catalina Sandino Moreno, David Alpay, Hannah Cheramy New Threat: The mysterious Man in Yellow escalates chaos after decapitating Jim Key Mystery: Will Jade and Tabitha’s revelations finally unlock the path home? Most Watched Series on MGM+ Returns with Bigger Horrors From season 4 marks the return of MGM+‘s biggest hit. The show has captivated audiences for three seasons with its twisted mythology of a cursed town where residents cannot escape. Harold Perrineau returns as Sheriff Boyd, the community’s exhausted leader struggling to hold society together. The fourth season promises his final days as his mind and body deteriorate from the supernatural strain. The series has earned a devoted global fan base who obsess over cryptic clues hidden throughout each episode. Bottle Trees, mysterious dates, and haunting messages have sparked endless theories. Now, with the Man in Yellow emerging as a major threat, season 4 will test whether anyone survives the truth. Jade and Tabitha’s Shocking Discovery Becomes Season 4’s Central Mystery Season 3 ended with a game-changing revelation. Jade and Tabitha, played by David Alpay and Catalina Sandino Moreno, learned they are reincarnations of past figures named Christopher and Miranda. These two have been trapped in an endless cycle of death and rebirth, repeatedly trying to protect murdered children from the town’s dark past. Season 4’s official synopsis teases that their discovery might finally unlock the mystery of escape. But the cost of knowledge will be higher than anyone expects. The closer residents get to answers, the more dangerous their situation becomes. Season 4 Release and Episode Guide Detail Information Premiere Date Sunday, April 19, 2026 at 9:00 PM ET/PT Streaming Platform MGM+ Release Format Weekly episode drops Total Episodes TBA (previous seasons had 10 episodes) “In Season 4, the closer the residents of town get to the answers they seek, the more terrifying their search becomes. Who is the Man in Yellow, and what does he want?” — MGM+ Official Synopsis The Man in Yellow Finally Faces His Reckoning Douglas E. Hughes returns as the chilling Man in Yellow, but season 4 will expose his true identity and motivations. In the season 3 finale, he brutally murdered Jim, played by Eion Bailey, while delivering an ominous warning to Tabitha and Jade. The teaser suggests season 4 will finally answer who he is and what role he plays in the town’s supernatural imprisonment. Beyond the Man in Yellow, new cast members arrive to shake up dynamics. Julia Doyle joins as Sophia, described as a sheltered pastor’s daughter whose arrival may trigger unforeseen consequences for the trapped residents. Will Anyone Actually Leave the Town in Season 4? After three seasons of horror, the central question remains unanswered. Can anyone escape the invisible border that traps everyone? Julie Matthews, played by Hannah Cheramy, discovered she’s a story walker, someone with the ability to time jump and influence past events. Season 4 will test whether this power provides a genuine escape route or leads to even darker consequences. The show promises that “some doors, once opened, will leave residents wishing they remained closed.” Season 4 launches in less than three weeks on MGM+. Are you ready for answers that might be worse than the mystery?
